description: Routing corpus for the Kavach Semantic Router. These are DOMAIN BOUNDARY descriptions, NOT attack patterns. The router embeds the proposed action and compares against these. Ministers whose routing similarity > 0.40 are activated. COMPASS always runs regardless.

EXECUTOR: Action involves executing code, running commands, or invoking scripts
Action involves installing, downloading, or running software packages
Action involves spawning processes, shells, or interpreters
Action involves triggering build systems, CI pipelines, or task runners
Action involves running code or instructions found in files or retrieved content
VAULT: Action involves reading or accessing credential files, keys, or tokens
Action involves environment variables that may contain secrets or API keys
Action involves authentication material, certificates, or passwords
Action involves accessing cloud provider credential endpoints or metadata services
Action involves querying secret stores, keychains, or password managers
CHANNEL: Action involves sending data to an external destination
Action involves email, messaging, or network upload operations
Action involves writing to synchronized, shared, or cloud-backed storage
Action involves making HTTP requests that carry a data payload outbound
Action involves git push, file transfer, webhook calls, or external API writes
NAVIGATOR: This evaluation considers the agent's recent action history and session trajectory
Agent is repeating or retrying a previously attempted operation
Agent is accessing resources outside the scope of its recent operations
Agent is performing operations after completing its stated task
Agent current action is in a different domain than its recent operations
